tasks.name: Set up project structure
tasks.description: Initialize the project with the necessary folder structure and configuration files.

tasks.name: Create frontend layout
tasks.description: Design a single-page layout with a text input field and a save button.

tasks.name: Implement text input functionality
tasks.description: Enable users to type text into the input field.

tasks.name: Set up backend server
tasks.description: Create a basic backend server to handle note-saving requests.

tasks.name: Implement save notes functionality
tasks.description: Allow users to save their notes by sending data to the backend.

tasks.name: Create database schema
tasks.description: Design a database schema to store the notes.

tasks.name: Integrate database with backend
tasks.description: Connect the backend server to the database for saving and retrieving notes.

tasks.name: Test text input functionality
tasks.description: Verify that users can type text into the input field without issues.

tasks.name: Test save notes functionality
tasks.description: Ensure that notes are saved correctly to the database and can be retrieved.

tasks.name: Deploy application
tasks.description: Deploy the application to a hosting environment for users to access.

T1.implementation_approach: Organize the project into folders for frontend, backend, and shared resources; initialize version control.
T1.notes: Ensure a clear and scalable structure for future development.

T2.implementation_approach: Design a responsive layout using HTML, CSS, and a frontend framework like React or Vue.
T2.notes: Focus on user-friendly design and cross-device compatibility.

T3.implementation_approach: Add a text input field with event listeners to capture user input and update the state.
T3.notes: Ensure real-time updates and proper validation.

T4.implementation_approach: Set up a Node.js server with Express to handle API requests and serve static files.
T4.notes: Configure CORS and middleware for security and functionality.

T5.implementation_approach: Create an API endpoint to save notes to the database and connect it to the frontend.
T5.notes: Ensure proper error handling and data validation.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a schema for storing notes using a database like MongoDB or PostgreSQL.
T6.notes: Include fields for note content, timestamps, and user identification if needed.

T7.implementation_approach: Use an ORM or database driver to connect the backend server to the database and perform CRUD operations.
T7.notes: Test database queries for efficiency and accuracy.

T8.implementation_approach: Write unit tests to verify the text input functionality and its integration with the frontend state.
T8.notes: Use a testing library like Jest or Cypress.

T9.implementation_approach: Test the save notes functionality by simulating API calls and verifying database updates.
T9.notes: Check for edge cases and error scenarios.

T10.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a platform like Heroku, Vercel, or AWS, and configure environment variables.
T10.notes: Ensure the deployment process includes proper build steps and security configurations.
